IUT2.Rem2_6_3.content: For a subgraph Gamma' of the line graph Gamma_Y (vertices Z), single-basepoint and splitting considerations force Gamma' connected and containing 0. For finite Gamma' define ||Gamma'|| = |Gamma'|^{-1} . sum over j in F_l* of min over integers j in (fiber of j) intersect Gamma' of j^2, where |Gamma'| is the cardinality of the image in F_l* of the nonzero vertices and the min over the empty set is 0. Claim (d): as a function of |Gamma'| this is a monotone increasing but not strictly increasing positive rational function that attains its maximum at |Gamma'| = l* and is constant for |Gamma'| >= l*.
explicit_hypotheses: Gamma' a finite connected subgraph of Gamma_Y containing the vertex 0
IUT2.Rem2_6_3.conclusion: Maximizing ||Gamma'|| is achieved by Gamma'_Y-black-triangle (vertices 0, ..., l*), and the values q_v^{j^2} are thereby distinguished.
obligations: Kernel-checked only for the elementary arithmetic: for Gamma' with vertex set [-a, b], |Gamma'| = min(max(a,b), l*) and ||Gamma'|| = (n+1)(2n+1)/6 with n = |Gamma'|, which is strictly increasing in n; hence ||Gamma'|| is monotone in max(a,b), maximal exactly when max(a,b) >= l*, with maximum l(l+1)/12. Infinite Gamma' (part (iii)) is not treated.
ambiguities: Page 79 defines |Gamma'| as the size of a subset of F_l*, so |Gamma'| <= l* always. Read literally, item (d) on page 80 then says ||Gamma'|| is a strictly increasing function of |Gamma'| on {1, ..., l*} (the Lean file proves this), which conflicts with 'not strictly increasing' and makes 'constant for |Gamma'| >= l*' vacuous beyond l*. The wording matches exactly if the variable is the radius max(a,b) of Gamma'; the Lean file proves both readings and adopts neither as the definition.

IUT2.Rem3_6_4.content: Explains why objects are known only up to isomorphism: Kummer N-th power morphisms respect multiplication but not addition, hence act as Frobenius-type morphisms between distinct ring structures, forcing the rigidity theory of [EtTh]. Galois evaluation is linear, so the first power of the theta function (and of its values) is the only power that crosses the mono-theta bridge; N-th powers for N > 1 are only defined as (-)^N of the first power, and other powers are not horizontal for the multiradial connection structure.

(i) constant prime-strip dagger F^{||-}_triangle with natural identification with dagger F^{||-}_mod (IUT I Definition 3.6 (c)), via the assignment '0, succ -> >' of Remark 3.8.2 (ii). (iii) functoriality gives maps Isom_{F^{||-}}(F_env, ddagger F_triangle) -> Isom_{F^{||- black-triangle x mu}}(F^{x mu}_env, ddagger F^{x mu}_triangle), and the same with gau, between nonempty sets; the Theta^{x mu}-link is the full poly-isomorphism dagger F^{||- black-triangle x mu}_env -> ddagger F^{||- black-triangle x mu}_triangle and the Theta^{x mu}_gau-link the full poly-isomorphism dagger F^{||- black-triangle x mu}_gau -> ddagger F^{||- black-triangle x mu}_triangle. (iv) natural isomorphisms F^{|- x mu}_triangle -> F^{|- x mu}_env -> F^{|- x mu}_gau; composing with the links gives the full poly-isomorphism dagger F^{|- x mu}_triangle -> ddagger F^{|- x mu}_triangle (an invariant of both links), inducing the full poly-isomorphism of D^{|-}-prime-strips (the D-Theta^{+-ell}NF-link). (v) the induced isomorphism of global realified data (D^{||-}, Prime, rho) is compatible with the R>0-orbits of the isomorphisms from (C^{||-}_triangle, Prime, rho). (vi) chains indexed by Z form an oriented graph with translation symmetry but no arbitrary permutation symmetries.
